projects.title: RateMyWeddingVenue
projects.description:
- Designed and implemented a website for user-generated reviews and ratings of Korean commercial wedding venues from the user’s perspective.
- Utilized MongoDB for the database; used Node.js and Express to build REST APIs to handle user, server, and database interaction.
-  Implemented account management using Mongoose schema, and EJS to make website dynamic according to user’s log in status.

projects.title: Gather
projects.description:
• Led a team of four to implement a website where people can get their personalized recipe recommendations and share their recipes with other users
• Utilized AWS Personalize to output user’s personal recipe recommendations
• Implemented text and speech-to-text chatbot that recommends recipes
• Populated Dynamo DB and Elasticsearch and implemented search feature getting data from the database
